manifest.description: Diagnose whether a Rust impl or module's actual behavior matches its declared role, receiver, module path, traits, attrs, and tests.
when_to_use: an impl or module appears to own responsibilities outside its declared role
method count and fan-out are only hotspot signals and the operator needs semantic ownership judgment
preparing a correction plan that may use rust-extract-impl-methods, rust-split-god-impl, or rust-extract-to-submodule
anti_patterns: do not use for method count or file size by itself
do not use for local cleanup that does not change ownership or boundaries
do not use on non-Rust targets
